description: The erection of a front porch; lower ground floor rear and rear side extension forming a balcony; double storey side extension; excavation of front lightwell and stairwell; ground floor rear and infill extension with sukkah roof; part first floor rear extension; hip to gable roof alteration and erection of front, erection of rear and side roof dormers.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details of at least one bat box and one bird nesting box (including their type, manufacturer’s specification, and precise location on the building) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved biodiversity enhancements shall be installed prior to the occupation of the development and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.</p><p>Reason: To enhance the ecological value of the site and ensure a net gain in biodiversity.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of external works (excluding demolition), a detailed landscaping scheme, including a schedule of landscape maintenance for a minimum period of 5 years,&nbsp;for both the front and rear gardens, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The scheme shall include details of all planting (including species, sizes, and densities), boundary treatments, hard surfacing materials, and maintenance arrangements. </p><p>All planting, seeding, or turfing approved shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding season following the occupation of the development or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any trees or plants which, within a period of five years after planting, are removed, die, or become seriously damaged or diseased in the opinion of the local planning authority, shall be replaced in the next available planting season with others of similar size, species, and number, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. </p><p>The approved landscaping shall be carried out prior to the first occupation of the development and maintained thereafter in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>Reason: To ensure a high-quality landscaped setting is retained at the site, to soften the appearance of the development, and to contribute to local biodiversity and visual amenities.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

All new external works in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution, and finished appearance.


REASON: In the interests of the visual amenities of the surrounding area.
